revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template: webtoon-shot-v1. Canvas 1536x2048 pixels with 6% safe margin. Single-panel ending shot for episode 1.

Scene/purpose: Theo sees a single breadcrumb again, and at the tip of his fingers forms his first irreversible resolve: the coming rapid thaw means hunger. Quiet, decisive ending. No text rendered.

Composition/camera: extreme close-up, top-down angle, portrait-lens feel, camera positioned directly above Theo’s fingertips on the dining table, subtle push-in feeling. Focus on one tiny breadcrumb pinched between index finger and thumb near image center. Leave a large quiet vertical-scroll empty feeling toward the lower portion for anticipation. Keep negative space visually calm in upper-left region for internal monologue placement later, but do not render any text.

Subject: Theo Waldhart only as a child hand close-up, no face, no full body. Small seven-year-old hand entering from left side around left 20%, top 43%, occupying about 50% width and 36% height overall in foreground. Pose: two fingers delicately holding a single crumb, hand paused mid-motion. Preserve childlike proportions, small soft fingers, blue-gray sleeve from his outfit, no adult hand, no face.

Background/location: Walt Fort dining hall table only, using the dining-hall identity from the reference as inspiration. Dark oak tabletop seen in stable top view. Scatter a few tiny crumbs nearby. Include very faint shallow soup steam near edge of frame, subtle and understated. Emphasize deep wood grain, warm beige-brown tones, ordinary dining warmth, no dramatic spotlight.

Visual treatment: clean restrained 2D webtoon close-up, highest sharpness on fingertips and tiny crumb, softer surrounding wood surface. Palette: dark wood brown, warm beige, blue-gray sleeve. Mood: silent but irreversible determination.

Continuity cues: Theo remains at the table after others left; this shot should imply he interprets the rapid thaw as the beginning of a food crisis and is about to investigate grain storage and debt records next episode.

Avoid: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, magic effects, face, full body, exaggerated firelight, oversized crumb, adult hand.
